payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been changed into a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Assess the image as a whole. Complete: pencil-drawing rendering is consistently evident across the scene, with drawn linework and pencil-like shading/texture shaping the image rather than merely overlaying a substantially photographic rendering. Partial: some pencil-drawing cues are evident, but substantial areas still read as photographic. Do not treat residual color or photographic detail alone as decisive; judge the overall rendering. Absent: no requested pencil-drawing transformation is evident. Unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress. Unrelated edits do not count.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: pencil drawing.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image has muted, pencil-like shading and a grainy drawn texture across the scene, but the food, glassware, and table setting retain substantial photographic detail rather than consistently reading as a pencil drawing.","confidence":0.94}
